add.text: All 4 methods: questions out of 100, each repeat separately
Agentic GraphRAG vs Normal RAG: questions out of 100, each repeat separately

Agentic GraphRAG only: Agentic GraphRAG fails in all 3 repeats while Normal RAG succeeds in all 3. Normal RAG only: the reverse. This table undercounts Agentic GraphRAG, which varies between repeats. Normal RAG retrieves the same text every repeat, so each question is found in 3 repeats or in 0. Read it together with the two tables below: they show in how many of the 3 repeats each method gets a question.
Agentic GraphRAG: questions right or found in N of the 3 repeats
Normal RAG: questions right or found in N of the 3 repeats

The two methods are level. Gold facts found are within 5 questions of each other at every threshold in every repeat, and Answered right has no consistent winner: Agentic GraphRAG is ahead in repeat 1, behind in repeat 2 and level in repeat 3. 67 questions never reach 100% of gold facts for either method in any repeat.

Normal RAG: questions right or found in N of the 3 repeats

Agentic GraphRAG leads on Answered right and on gold facts found ≥50% and ≥75% in every repeat. At 100% the two are level in repeats 1 and 3 (15 each), and Agentic GraphRAG is ahead in repeat 2 (19 vs 15). 78 questions never reach 100% of gold facts for either method in any repeat.

Agentic GraphRAG only: Agentic GraphRAG fails in all 3 repeats while Normal RAG succeeds in all 3. Normal RAG only: the reverse. This table undercounts Agentic GraphRAG, which varies between repeats. Normal RAG retrieves the same text every repeat, so each question is found in 3 repeats or in 0. Read it together with the two tables below: they show in how many of the 3 repeats each method gets a question.
Agentic GraphRAG: questions right or found in N of the 3 repeats
Normal RAG: questions right or found in N of the 3 repeats

Every method answers 95 to 98 of 100 inference questions right in every repeat, so the method hardly matters here. Gold facts found are level between Agentic GraphRAG and Normal RAG, within 4 questions of each other at every threshold in every repeat, and 85 questions never reach 100% of gold facts for either method in any repeat.
Null questions have no gold facts, so they have no retrieval numbers.
